items.title: The new TONE3000 is FREE and provides access to countless NAM profiles
items.excerpt: TONE3000 has released a free plugin for macOS, Windows and Linux that plays back Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) captures, opening a huge library of neural-modelled amps, cabs, pedals and outboard to any DAW. Neural capture is quietly becoming the default way guitar and studio gear gets emulated — sound and reactive behaviour, not just static impulse responses.
items.rationale: 풀에서 가장 신선하고(09-02) 가장 실무적인 릴리스 — 무료 플러그인 하나로 뉴럴 캡처 앰프/아웃보드 라이브러리 전체가 어떤 DAW에서든 열린다.

items.title: Logic Pro 12.3, as reviewed by a Cubase version 1 user
items.excerpt: A lifelong Cubase user reviews Logic Pro 12.3 and lands on its AI features as the reason to switch: Session Players that conjure convincing bass, drum and keyboard parts from a project's chords and groove, plus "one of the best stem separation processes I've encountered". A concrete read on how AI performers reshape a DAW workflow.
items.rationale: AI 세션 플레이어와 스템 분리가 DAW 갈아탈 이유가 되는지 30년 크로스그레이드 관점에서 검증한다 — 내일 세션에서 바로 판단이 갈리는 항목.

items.title: Elastic Melody now does bass and DFAM-style percussion, too (Mac, iOS)
items.excerpt: Elastic Melody, a go-to algorithmic melody generator for Mac, iPad and iPhone, adds Pitch and Filter Drive modes so the same generative engine can now write basslines and DFAM-style percussion. It is a case study in generative composition as an instrument rather than a prompt box.
items.rationale: 프롬프트 상자가 아니라 악기로서의 제너레이티브 작곡 — 같은 엔진이 멜로디에서 베이스와 퍼커션까지 넓어지며 실제 편곡 파트를 맡는다.

items.title: Lucinate video synth animates and live-codes visuals on Mac and iOS
items.excerpt: From the makers of AUM, Lucinate is a real-time Metal-based visual environment for macOS and iOS that works as a ready-to-play, Ableton Link-synced video synth and opens up to live coding. A generative visualizer pipeline for musicians who don't want to render a music video.
items.rationale: 뮤직비디오를 렌더링하는 대신 Ableton Link에 물려 실시간으로 비주얼을 연주한다 — 릴리스와 라이브 영상 작업의 공정 자체를 바꾸는 도구.

items.title: AI models can identify iconic jazz pianists based on their recordings, while also revealing their "musical fingerprints"
items.excerpt: New research shows machine-learning models can name the jazz pianist behind a recording and, in doing so, expose the measurable "musical fingerprint" of a player's touch, timing and voicing. Researchers say it could suggest authors for unattributed works.
items.rationale: 연주자의 터치·타이밍·보이싱이 측정 가능한 지문이 된다는 연구 — 저작 귀속과 스타일 분석 양쪽에 쓰일 수 있는, 도구 릴리스와 결이 다른 통찰.

Checked and cleared as distinct: Elastic Melody 1.2 (CDM) vs the 08-29 card music-or1 (Organismi OR-1, Synthtopia) — different products, different releases. MusicRadar jazz 'musical fingerprints' research vs the 09-01 card music-jazz-profile-hijack (DMN, spam farms on jazz profiles) — unrelated stories that merely share the word jazz. TONE3000 (NAM playback plugin) vs the 08-28 card music-quad-cortex-coros (Neural DSP CorOS 4.1.0) — different vendors and releases.

Two CDM items kept: cdm.link/elastic-melody-1-2/ and cdm.link/lucinate-visuals-on-mac-and-ios/ are distinct products and distinct URLs, published 5 days apart — not a content-hub duplicate. Outlet cap of 2 respected.
